source: Self-authored corpus for domain-boundary-provenance-hook Slice 3, per docs/tooling/domain-boundary-provenance-hook.md §6's fixture-corpus requirement and §8 AC7's named minimum case list. Paired with tests/fixtures/domain_boundary_manifest_fixture.json (schemaVersion 1, pipelineConfigGlobs: docs/tooling/*.json + pipelines/*/config.json + pipelines/*/spec.json, externalSourceIdentifiers: EXTERNAL_CAP_V1, MARKET_DATA_FLOOR, re:UNIVERSE_[A-Z_]+_THRESHOLD). Each case's file_path is repo-root-relative unless is_absolute is true, in which case the test harness must join it onto the fixture project root to produce a real absolute path before invoking the probe -- the corpus itself cannot express an absolute path, since the project root only exists at test-run time (tmp_path).
note_ac7_wording: SUPERSEDED (benchmark-verified F3 fix): the prior PROXIMITY_WINDOW = 5 constant this note described had a false citation (measured a different population than what it governed) and no real citation exists or can be cheaply obtained. Disposition: the DOMAIN-BOUNDARY: marker now must be on the SAME LINE as the matched identifier -- no line-distance window at all. See case id distance_1_boundary_denies (replaces the removed distance_5_boundary_allows case).

cases.description: No manifest present at docs/tooling/domain-boundary-manifest.json -> allow, manifest_status absent_or_invalid.

File does not match any pipelineConfigGlobs entry -> cross_domain allows with file_in_scope false. Since Slice 7 the local-threshold pass ALSO runs on this .py file regardless of manifest scope, and `EXTERNAL_CAP_V1 = 5` is itself an unmarked module-level assignment, so the combined (log_only default) decision is now 'flag', not 'allow' -- correct composed behavior, not a regression.
In-scope file whose content contains no externalSourceIdentifiers match -> allow, matches_found 0.
cases.content: totally unrelated content, nothing tracked here

cases.description: In-scope match with a qualifying DOMAIN-BOUNDARY marker on the same line -> allow.
cases.content: EXTERNAL_CAP_V1 = 5  # DOMAIN-BOUNDARY: sourced from market_data's daily_universe view, see DDR-0014

cases.description: In-scope match with no qualifying marker anywhere in the window -> flag under the log_only default (this corpus runs with no domain-boundary-mode.json present, so mode is always log_only; an unconditional deny only happens under mode == 'blocking', per Architecture Slice 6's F1 behavior change).

Marker at distance 6 (lines) from the match -- one line past the inclusive 5-line window -- must flag under the log_only default (no domain-boundary-mode.json present in this corpus; an unconditional deny only happens under mode == 'blocking'). AC7 names this 'boundary case at line 6'.
cases.content:
EXTERNAL_CAP_V1 = 5
filler line 1
filler line 2
filler line 3
filler line 4
filler line 5
# DOMAIN-BOUNDARY: too far away

cases.description: PROXIMITY_WINDOW was removed (benchmark-verified unsourced number, docs/tooling/domain-boundary-provenance-hook.md §5 superseded) -- the DOMAIN-BOUNDARY: marker must now be on the SAME LINE as the match. A marker at distance 1 (the smallest possible off-line distance) no longer qualifies and must deny (downgraded to flag under this corpus's log_only mode). Replaces the prior distance-5-boundary-allows case, which tested the now-deleted window's inclusive edge.
cases.content:
EXTERNAL_CAP_V1 = 5
# DOMAIN-BOUNDARY: one line away, no longer qualifies

cases.description: Edit whose new_string never touches the pre-existing uncited match elsewhere in the file -- scan surface is new_string only, so this must not be denied.
cases.new_string: totally unrelated replacement text, no identifiers here

cases.description: A manifest glob written relative to repo root (docs/tooling/*.json) must match a realistic, non-relativized ABSOLUTE tool_input.file_path -- the real PreToolUse envelope shape. Resolves to flag, not deny, under this corpus's log_only default (no domain-boundary-mode.json present).

Slice 9 — local-threshold pass, context 1 (comparison operand), end-to-end through run()/combine(). No manifest present, so cross_domain is absent_or_invalid; local_threshold finds one uncited comparison literal -> flag under log_only.
Slice 9 — local-threshold pass, context 2 (slice/truncation argument), end-to-end.
Slice 9 — local-threshold pass, context 3 (module/class-level named assignment), end-to-end.
Slice 9 — citation-satisfying form (a): a file-path-shaped THRESHOLD-PROVENANCE: token within the 2-line window -> allow, end-to-end.

2026-09-06 — the named-owner acceptance form (b) was DELETED (Danny's ruling: no owner-name acceptance path of any kind, for any constant, ever). A THRESHOLD-PROVENANCE: owner: <name> with no citation must now flag, end-to-end, not allow.

Slice 9 / G-2 resolution (05-REVIEW.md, CRITICAL) — a THRESHOLD-PROVENANCE: marker present but bearing only bare 'PROVISIONAL' text (no citation, no owner:) must resolve to unmarked/flagged end-to-end through run_local_threshold_pass()/combine(), not merely at the unit level. Prior to this pass's owner-required fix, this exact fixture would have incorrectly passed as cited.
Slice 9 — test-path-component exclusion, end-to-end: file_path has a 'tests' path component, so the local-threshold pass never scans it (file_scanned false), regardless of content.
Slice 9 — non-slice-stop-index exclusion, end-to-end: a plain subscript index (data[i], not a Slice node) produces no flags; file is scanned but finds nothing.

Slice 9 — combination-rule corpus case: an in-scope .py file (manifest glob widened to *.py) with an uncited cross-domain identifier in a comment (so it isn't also picked up as a threshold assignment) AND a separate uncited threshold-shaped assignment -> both passes flag, single combined 'flag' decision under log_only.

Architecture §8/§13, G-9 (reopened and resolved this pass) — scanning this probe's OWN current source (read live from scripts/domain_boundary_provenance_probe.py at test-run time via content_source: self_probe_source, never a duplicated literal snapshot that could drift) through run()/combine() end-to-end. PROXIMITY_WINDOW = 5 is a module-level named assignment with no THRESHOLD-PROVENANCE: comment, so it IS flagged as unmarked; PROXIMITY_WINDOW_THRESHOLD = 2 carries its own citation and is NOT flagged. This is a confirmed self-scan finding (reported to Danny for routing per Architecture §11), not silently fixed here. The track-record entry only carries aggregate counts (matches_found > matches_cited proves SOMETHING is unmarked); test_self_scan_flags_proximity_window_specifically_not_proximity_window_threshold (in this same test file) separately confirms WHICH literal.

Absolute tool_input.file_path resolving outside $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR entirely -> allow, file_in_scope false, no glob match attempted (the step 3 fail-open edge case). is_absolute_outside_root signals the harness to build this path against a sibling directory of the fixture project root, not under it.
